name: share.set
description: Who a share link opens for (anyone with it, or the team only) and what a guest may do (view, comment or edit).
sql:
insert into brandbase.share_links as l (token, brand_id, kind, target_id, who, can)
values (brandbase.new_token(), :brand, :kind, :id, coalesce(:who, 'link'), coalesce(:can, 'comment'))
on conflict (kind, target_id) do update set who = coalesce(:who, l.who), can = coalesce(:can, l.can)
returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(l)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(l.created_at)) as result
